context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: Generate Multi-Environment Infrastructure Structure.

checklist.name: Directory tree shown before files
checklist.description: Agent presents the complete directory tree (`infrastructure/` with `root.hcl`, `dev/`, `prod/` subdirectories) before showing file contents

checklist.name: root.hcl is environment-agnostic
checklist.description: `root.hcl` does not reference `env.hcl`, does not hard-code `dev` or `prod`, and uses `path_relative_to_include()` for the state key

checklist.name: Child modules read env.hcl via read_terragrunt_config
checklist.description: All four child `terragrunt.hcl` files include a `locals` block reading `env.hcl` and use `local.env.locals.*` for environment-specific values

checklist.name: app dependency on vpc has mock_outputs
checklist.description: Both `app/terragrunt.hcl` files (dev and prod) have a dependency on `../vpc` with at least one `mock_output` and `mock_outputs_allowed_terraform_commands`

checklist.name: prod/app has prevent_destroy=true
checklist.description: `infrastructure/prod/app/terragrunt.hcl` includes `prevent_destroy = true`; `dev/app` does not require it
